operator_instruction.text: 重新 pin 到現況，把 033 放回 pending
operator_instruction.meaning: re-pin the drifted registered inputs to their current content and return 033 to the pending queue

trigger.root_cause: Two registered inputs drifted from their pinned sha256 while 033 sat in the queue. inputs[5] scoring_reference was edited after preregistration to add five cfg 3.0 content cells. inputs[10] notification_helper was changed by amendment receipt-notifier-binding-live-hash-fix-20260902, whose contract_repin updated notification_receipts.helper_sha256 but not the inputs[] entry naming the same file, so that amendment's re-pin was incomplete and would have produced a second hold immediately after the first was cleared.

allowed: Re-pin inputs[5].sha256/bytes (scripts/eval/negprompt_ablation_matrix.py) to its current committed content.

Re-pin inputs[10].sha256/bytes (scripts/experiment_harness/notification_receipts.py) to the helper this contract already declares under notification_receipts.helper_sha256, completing the re-pin declared by receipt-notifier-binding-live-hash-fix-20260902.
Archive this contract's superseded seat_attempt and held receipts so the immutable-binding check does not reject the next seat attempt.
forbidden: Change data, checkpoint, subset, seed, hyperparameters, CFG, solver steps, precision, mask mode, conditioning, metrics, negative cell registry, thresholds, or queue order.
Relax any preflight, storage, or ordering gate.

changes.content_delta: Adds five c2p0_slot0 cells at cfg 3.0 for fidelity_short, silence, reversed, irrelevant and neutral. Additive to build_cells() only.
changes.rationale: 033 does not execute this file. It is registered as a provenance reference because 033's comparator numbers were produced by it. The five added cells extend the matrix at cfg 3.0 and change none of 033's registered protocol fields, so re-pinning preserves the provenance link without altering the preregistered experiment.

This is the same file and the same post_sha256 that receipt-notifier-binding-live-hash-fix-20260902 already approved and wrote into this contract's notification_receipts.helper_sha256. Only the duplicate inputs[] entry was missed. No new authorization is exercised.

receipt_migration.reason: notification_receipts.deliver_required rejects a re-delivered event whose binding differs from the stored receipt, and contract_sha256 is part of that binding. The superseded receipts are archived rather than deleted, following superseded_by_amendment_20260902 and superseded_by_notifier_restore_20260902.

queue_effect: 033_single_negprompt_cfg3_ablation returns from p2/held to p2/pending in its preregistered position. No reordering, no new work, no change to the experiment itself.
